Author: Isaiahfeldt
Name: Dualcast Gem
Punchline: A glowing gem for Red Mage's Dualcast.
Description: Displays a movable crystal: blue while Swiftcast is active, ruby red for Dualcast, gray otherwise. Swiftcast takes priority when both are active. Includes size, opacity, position lock, combat-only visibility, and previews. Configure with /dualcastgem.
Changelog: Added blue Swiftcast state with priority over Dualcast and previews for all three states.
